messages:
mika: Heads-up — weekend freeze window starts Sat 06:00 PT and ends Mon 06:00 PT. Posting the handoff + rapid-unpin procedure. Please ack if you'll be on rotation.

samir: Acked. I'll be primary on-call Sat 06-18 PT.

amy: I'm backup for Sat afternoon. Adding checklist items now.

mika: Quick summary: no non-critical deploys during freeze. Emergency hotfixes allowed after quick triage + double-approval. We have pinned runtime to `model-v3.4.2-quant` for all hosted traffic.

deploy-bot: Pinned model -> model-v3.4.2-quant across prod clusters at 2024-11-02T06:00Z. Freeze flag set: true.

jorge: Noting: Dedicated customers with committed capacity can still request maintenance windows via support, but changes need release-czar signoff.

mika: Handoff checklist (short):
- Confirm pin is active: `deploy-bot status pin`
- Verify canary traffic stable for 60m: check `observability/canary/v3.4.2`
- Rollback plan present in PR with steps + manifest refs
- Release notes link posted in #product after code freeze

amy: Adding one more: confirm infra autoscale alarms for GPU slots (we saw noisy OOM last time).

samir: Got it. I'll run a quick smoke run Sat 05:30 PT and post results.

deploy-bot: Canary snapshot: 99.6% healthy over 1h,  p50 latency 42ms, p95 168ms.

mika: Rapid-unpin / breakglass procedure (2-steps):
1) Owner posts emergency thread in #eng-releases with `EMERGENCY UNPIN` and short rationale.
2) Two-signal approval from Release Czar + oncall (explicit `+1` replies). After approvals, deploy-bot will unpin and fallback to `model-v3.3.1-fallback` for up to 30 minutes while we triage.

release-czar: Confirming — I will be one approver for weekend. If I'm unreachable, Jorge is secondary.

jorge: Also note: unpin triggers must include a smoke prompt set id and test run link. We won't unpin blind.

samir: For rollback vs rollforward decision tree: if regression is functional (broken responses), rollback to previous pinned variant. If perf only (latency), consider unpin -> fallback or scale up GPU temporarily depending on severity.

mika: Example EMERGENCY UNPIN format (paste into thread):
```
EMERGENCY UNPIN: high-rate hallucination on /chat generate v3.4.2-quant
Owner: @samir
Evidence: logs + sample conversation link
Suggested fallback: model-v3.3.1-fallback
Approvals: @release-czar + @mika
Action window: 30m
```

ops-bot: Reminder: manual unpin requires a deploy annotation in the audit log. Use `opsctl audit add --ticket <ID> --reason "unpin emergency"`.

amy: For record-keeping, I'll create a tiny release-notes stub now pointing to the changelog and QA summary.

mika: Anything else? If not, please ack this thread so we have a visible handoff record.

samir: Ack. I'll post smoke results and set quiet-monitor dashboards Sat 05:45 PT.

amy: Ack. I'll be reachable on phone for approvals.

jorge: Ack — leaving my zoom open 05:50-06:20 PT in case of last-minute huddle.

deploy-bot: Freeze window: active. Pin: model-v3.4.2-quant. Canary health: OK.

mika: Thanks team — closing the handoff. If an emergency unpin happens, follow the EMERGENCY UNPIN format exactly so approvals are fast. :thumbsup:
